provenance: Original content — The Verdant Maw, © 2026 Example Campaign
note: One monster and its ecosystem, in five records. The maw itself has speed 0 and reach 15: it is a location that eats things.

creatures.name: Verdant Maw
unmodelled: Rooted in place: speed 0, and it cannot be moved or made to follow
Swallows a Medium creature it has held for two rounds

creatures.name: Verdant Maw Lure-Bloom
unmodelled: Smells like whatever the nearest creature most wants to eat
Killing the blooms does not harm the maw; it grows more in a day

spells.name: Maw-Song
unmodelled: Not cast by the maw, which cannot cast. Druids who study it learn this

conditions.name: verdant-lured
conditions.description: The creature wants very much to walk toward the flowers.

items.name: Maw-Sap Antidote
items.description: Distilled from the maw's own sap. It closes what the maw opens.
unmodelled: Harvesting the sap requires reaching into the maw, which is the joke
